meta.source: Inspired by Cards Against Humanity (CC BY-NC-SA 2.0). Bangladeshi Bengali adaptation, written not translated.
meta.audience: adults with a sense of humor
meta.design_principle: Combinatoric: every white card is a noun-phrase that can grammatically fill any black-card blank. Mix registers — cultural pressure points + bodily humor (পাদ, ঢেকুর, গন্ধ, ঘাম, নাক ডাকা) — so unexpected pairings produce the biggest laughs.
meta.notes: Mock cultural patterns and power structures, not religious belief or victims. Dark humor punches up — at perpetrators, corruption, impunity, state violence, family dysfunction. No anatomical/explicit content — bodily humor stays in fart/burp/sweat/snore territory.
